## Featured Projects

- [Hire Me OS 2.0](/project/hire-me-os) — Autonomous career intelligence SaaS with 6-block job evaluation, Autopilot 24/7 scheduler, AI resume tailor, and Chrome extension. Built with React, FastAPI, LangChain.
- [Doc AI (Ultra Doc Intelligence)](/project/doc-ai) — Logistics document intelligence with hybrid BM25 + ChromaDB RAG, HIPAA-compliant PII masking via Microsoft Presidio, and confidence-scored Q&A.
- [AI Meal Planner](/project/meal-planner) — Personalized nutrition planning with LLM-powered meal generation, macro tracking, and adaptive recommendations.
